cjo_candidate_projection.boundary: A projection for the existing CJO compiler; it is not a Frozen CJO and cannot authorize value, price, BuyBand, report publication, or investment action.
cjo_candidate_projection.central_path: The cookware-weighted incumbent has a usable three-year adjusted consolidated earnings record and channel reach, but the cash route is weaker and conditional because working capital, long-lived-asset spending and debt rose or deteriorated in aggregate. New robot, new-energy and logistics capital receives no incremental return credit until its economics are evidenced.

component_decisions.invalidation_test: Like-for-like disclosure shows that the cookware-weighted incumbent business loses earnings power or that the consolidated reference is dominated by a non-incumbent component.
component_decisions.promotion_test: Disclose a consistent product- and channel-level bridge showing that the incumbent earnings reference is supported by durable margin and collection economics.

component_decisions.invalidation_test: The reconciliation shows that cash conversion and funding needs are materially weaker than implied by the reported aggregate deterioration, or that financing pressure is greater and cannot be sustained.
component_decisions.promotion_test: A common-boundary reconciliation separates operating cash, economic maintenance capital, growth capital, working-capital absorption, debt and restricted assets.

component_decisions.invalidation_test: Component disclosure establishes continuing cash absorption or inadequate return on the committed capital, or establishes that the activity is immaterial.
component_decisions.promotion_test: For each material activity, provide responsibility-matched evidence of customer acceptance, revenue, cost, working capital, cumulative cash and return on capital.

component_treatments.investment_consequence: Eligible only for the incumbent earning-power route; no separate growth increment, product-line profit allocation or channel premium is supplied.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Maintain the treatment only if subsequent like-for-like disclosure continues to connect the cookware-weighted incumbent business to earnings without a conflicting component boundary.
component_treatments.reason: FY2017 identifies cookware as the product emphasis, and reported revenue and adjusted profit attributable to shareholders increased in each of FY2015-FY2017. The disclosed figures are consolidated, so the treatment is an incumbent enterprise reference rather than a product-level allocation.

component_treatments.investment_consequence: Owner cash remains a conditional range and financing pressure is active; all long-lived-asset spending is treated as current capital-allocation and financing pressure, not as an asserted maintenance-capital amount.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Reconcile operating cash, maintenance spending, growth spending, working capital, debt and restricted assets on a common responsible-business boundary.
component_treatments.reason: Aggregate FY2017 operating cash flow declined from FY2016 while payments for long-lived assets increased; receivables, inventory and borrowings also increased. The package does not separate maintenance capital from growth capital or allocate these facts among components.

component_treatments.investment_consequence: Do not credit incremental normal earnings, owner cash or capital return from these activities; retain an unresolved route so their possible financing and permanent-loss effects remain visible.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Obtain a matched project or component bridge from customer acceptance through revenue, cost, working capital, cumulative cash and return on all committed capital.
component_treatments.reason: The source identifies robot, new-energy and logistics investments, but supplies no component-level revenue, customer acceptance, cost, operating cash, working capital, financing or return on the disclosed capital.

cjo_candidate_projection.monitoring: Monitor the three copied reversal observations: like-for-like incumbent economics, a responsibility-matched cash and capital reconciliation, and project-level customer-to-cash-to-return disclosure for expansion activities.
cjo_candidate_projection.normal_earnings_treatment: Use only the bounded FY2015-FY2017 adjusted-profit reference for incumbent consolidated earning power; do not convert revenue growth, unadjusted net profit or disclosed new-project funding into an additional normal-earnings claim.
cjo_candidate_projection.owner_cash_treatment: Operating cash less economic maintenance capital is unknown. Operating cash less all disclosed long-lived-asset spending is retained solely as current capital-allocation and financing-pressure evidence, while the subsequent return on growth capital is unresolved.
cjo_candidate_projection.permanent_loss_treatment: Treat low-return retention, working-capital absorption, debt dependence and an unproven expansion return as conditional slow-erosion paths; do not confuse continued operations or consolidated cash flow with established ordinary-share owner cash.

industry_future_thesis.adaptation: The disclosed marketing network, online-platform coverage and international-retailer quality relationships show channel access, while the record does not establish product- or channel-level price, margin, collection or return economics.

industry_future_thesis.most_likely_regime: A mature, channel-diverse consumer-durables core in which reported sales growth is useful only when it converts through margins and working capital; separately funded expansion must earn its way into the enterprise case.
industry_future_thesis.normal_economics: The FY2015-FY2017 adjusted-profit record is usable as a bounded incumbent consolidated reference, not as proof that every product line or new project has the same economics.
industry_future_thesis.permanent_loss: The principal slow-loss path is retaining or borrowing capital for working-capital absorption and new projects whose matched cash return is undisclosed, while a rival can contest the cookware profit pool through brand and channel execution.
industry_future_thesis.profit_pool_transmission: The disclosed revenue and adjusted-profit increase can support incumbent earning power, but receivables, inventory, long-lived-asset spending and borrowing determine whether the same growth reaches ordinary-share cash rather than absorbing financing capacity.

industry_future_thesis.profit_pool_transmission: The disclosed revenue and adjusted-profit increase can support incumbent earning power, but receivables, inventory, long-lived-asset spending and borrowing determine whether the same growth reaches ordinary-share cash rather than absorbing financing capacity.
reversal_observations: 后续同口径披露显示炊具或消费耐用品的收入、利润或现金转化没有随已披露销售增长改善，或者产品和渠道组合与当前判断不同。
后续披露能在同一责任边界内对经营现金、维持性支出、增长性长期资产投入、应收和存货以及借款进行对账，并显著改变当前的现金与融资压力判断。
后续按机器人、新能源或物流项目披露客户接受、收入、成本、营运资本、累计现金和投入回报，证明该项目可或不可从未决路线晋升。
industry_future_thesis.strongest_rival: 苏泊尔；FY2017 披露将其与爱仕达同列为炊具内销领导品牌，并称爱仕达在商超渠道有品牌优势。
industry_future_thesis.valuation_treatment: Keep incumbent earning power distinct from the conditional owner-cash route and exclude unmeasured robot, new-energy and logistics incremental returns from any resolved route.

situation_model.summary: The reported business is cookware-weighted, sold through domestic branding, overseas distributors and expanding online channels. Consolidated revenue and adjusted profit rose through FY2017, but cash conversion and financing pressure weakened while new robot, new-energy and logistics investments lack responsibility-matched operating evidence.
